description: La Grange Optimised Areas for Irrigated Agriculture (DPIRD-004) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. The Department of Primary Industry and Regional Development - Agriculture and Food conducted the four-year La Grange project, as part of the Regional Economic Development Water Opportunities (REDWO) project, funded by Royalties for Regions. The land and water assessment component of the project was conducted to identify suitable land for irrigated agriculture. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. Its tags are La Grange, irrigated agriculture, soils. It offers 9 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, docx, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
